```python
# app.py
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
import random

app = Flask(__name__)

# Simple neutral responses to illustrate behavior
NEUTRAL_RESPONSES = [
    "Hello — how can I assist you today?",
    "I can help with that. Please provide more details.",
    "Here are some options you can try.",
    "Thanks for the info. I will look up the next steps."
]

def generate_public_reply(user_message):
    # Very simple reply generation for the example
    return random.choice(NEUTRAL_RESPONSES)

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    data = request.json or {}
    user = data.get("user", "guest")
    user_message = data.get("message", "")

    public_reply = generate_public_reply(user_message)

    # Internal note for operators: provenance and system role
    internal_note = {
        "system_role": "automated_assistant_neutral_persona",
        "provenance": {
            "model": "example-model-1.0",
            "timestamp": "2026-03-10T00:00:00Z"
        },
        "disclosure_policy": "Operators must adhere to rules about explicit automated-assistant disclosure. The public interface uses a neutral persona and does not state 'I am an AI'."
    }

    return jsonify({
        "user": user,
        "reply": public_reply,
        # internal_note is included for operators only; in production restrict access
        "internal_note": internal_note
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(port=5000, debug=True)
```
